heading: Property of the United States
lead: The following are hereby declared the property of the United States:

tree.text: The name and character “Woodsy Owl” and the associated slogan, “Give a Hoot, Don’t Pollute”.

notes.text: Codification Section was formerly classified to section 488b–4 of Title 31 prior to the general revision and enactment of Title 31, Money and Finance, by Pub. L. 97–258, § 1, Sept. 13, 1982, 96 Stat. 877.
